title: The Litany Engine
premise: Every chamber seems arranged to continue a prayer that no living voice remembers.

sensory: The air carries a dry mineral taste of powdered bone.
Tiny clicks move through the walls whenever the room goes quiet.
visual: The mortar is packed with folded prayer slips and pale hair.
hazards: A pressure slab releases hanging bonework when crossed carelessly.
A thread of rosary beads pulls open a reliquary of sharp fragments.
rewards: A bone fragment acts as a key to sacred locks.

componentPlacements.summary: The location behaves like a devotional machine built from arranged remains.
componentPlacements.text: Every chamber seems arranged to continue a prayer that no living voice remembers.

componentPlacements.summary: The air carries a dry mineral taste of powdered bone.
componentPlacements.text: The room tastes dry and mineral, as if each breath scrapes through old bone dust.

componentPlacements.summary: Tiny clicks move through the walls whenever the room goes quiet.
componentPlacements.text: Small clicks travel through the bonework, like teeth settling after speech.

componentPlacements.summary: A pressure slab releases hanging bonework when crossed carelessly.
componentPlacements.text: A sermon text is carved into a floor slab polished by knees and footsteps.

componentPlacements.summary: A skull row reveals that one skull has been replaced recently.
componentPlacements.text: One skull in the row is cleaner than the others, and the dust line behind it does not match.

componentPlacements.summary: Bone ornaments create brittle cover and collapsing lines of sight.
componentPlacements.text: Skull shelves and femur screens divide the room into narrow devotional lanes.
